result.evidence: The Zeus 3S is the main product of the manual and is a multifunction display by B&G/Navico. Related radar models from Simrad (Halo20, Halo20+, Halo24, Broadband 4G) are clustered by suffix and referenced as compatible radar systems. Sailing processors from B&G (H5000, Hercules, Triton Edge) are listed separately due to different model names. Cameras from FLIR and Axis are listed individually as they differ significantly. Other referenced products such as digital switching devices, sonar modules, audio servers, mobile apps, and remote controls are listed flat as they integrate with the primary product.
